operator_name.description: Human-readable name published in the operator log list.

logs.description: Dictionary CT log shard names to configurations.

friendly_name.description: Brief human-readable name for the log.

intended_use.description: The operator's intended use for the log.

status.description: The intended operational state of the log.

status_timestamp.description: When the current status was set.

start_inclusive.description: All certificates must expire on this date or later.

end_exclusive.description: All certificates must expire before this date.

location_hint.description: Provide a hint to place the log in a specific geographic location. See https://developers.cloudflare.com/durable-objects/reference/data-location/ for supported locations. If unspecified, the Durable Object will be created in proximity to the first request.

sequence_interval_millis.description: The duration in between sequencing operations, in milliseconds.

max_sequence_skips.description: The maximum number of times sequencing can be skipped to avoid creating partial tiles. If non-zero, pending entries may be delayed by either a multiple of the sequence interval or sequence_skip_threshold_millis if set.

sequence_skip_threshold_millis.description: If provided, entries will only be skipped by sequencing (when max_sequenced_skips is non-zero) if they have been in the pool for less than this timeout.

num_batchers.description: The number of batchers to use to proxy requests to the sequencer. If zero, requests from the frontend worker go directly to the sequencer.

batch_timeout_millis.description: The maximum duration to wait before submitting a batch to the sequencer, in milliseconds.

max_batch_entries.description: The maximum number of entries per batch.

enable_dedup.description: Enables checking the deduplication cache for add-(pre-)chain requests. Can be disabled for tests and benchmarks. If disabled, `kv_namespaces` can be omitted from `wrangler.jsonc`.

enable_ccadb_roots.description: Enables loading root store trusted roots from the CCADB list, in addition to any roots configured in `roots.<env>.pem`. If enabled, requires a KV namespace with the binding `ccadb_roots` to be configured in `wrangler.jsonc`, as well as a cron trigger so that the CCADB list auto-updates. The CCADB cron job only ever appends roots to the list, but manual changes can be made if necessary.

reject_expired.description: Rejects submissions whose leaf certificate has expired.

clean_interval_secs.description: How long to wait in between runs of the partial tile cleaner. For static CT, the cleaner can clean 498 tiles (127,488 entries) per run before hitting the Workers limit of 1000 subrequests, so the default of once every 60 seconds should keep up with a log that grows at 2000 entries/second.

include_in_operator_list.description: Include this log's metadata URL in the operator log list.
